purpose: Cross-context technical replication, resolution bridging, event-feature stratification, patient-equal estimands and source-verified surgical subgroup feasibility; no manuscript or public release changes
design_status: Existing database summaries have already been seen. This additional protocol is frozen before computing the new bridge, strata and equal-patient effects, not claimed prospectively registered or untouched external validation.

sources.VitalDB: Frozen original 10-s MAP and metadata; primary shared-window comparison retains original reference, with objective core60 onset as a separately labelled sensitivity
sources.MIMIC: Frozen fully waveform-screened monitor-numeric 10-s MAP; confirmed adults, records fully inside linked ICU stay and arterial numeric family; no waveform-mean imputation
sources.SICdb: Hash-verified extracted native-minute arterial MAP/SBP/DBP shards; no interpolation or synthetic 10-s data

age: Common comparison uses confirmed age or SICdb 5-year age-bin lower bound >=25. If exact age is not retained for MIMIC, use verified clinical metadata; otherwise report age-harmonization unavailability and keep confirmed-adult MIMIC as labelled non-age-matched secondary comparison. Do not infer age from diagnoses.
reference_versions: Source-specific upstream QC remains frozen. A shared 20-180 numeric filter is not claimed to equalize upstream measurement quality. VitalDB core60 masks prequalified-onset values only and preserves the original grid.

selection.native10s: Original-record-origin complete nonoverlapping hours with >=288/360 finite reference bins; all qualifying hours, no hypotension-based selection
selection.minute: For VitalDB/MIMIC, full minutes of six 10-s bins require >=5 finite bins; median primary, first-bin alternative. SICdb retains native minutes. Complete origin-zero hours require >=48/60 finite minutes.
selection.paired_bridge: VitalDB/MIMIC only: intersection of qualifying native and minute hours. Both resolutions use exactly the same record-hour positions; missing remains missing, no concatenation. Apply >=180-s event endpoint to both; >=60-s native endpoint separately quantifies short-event information absent from coarse data.
selection.first_hour: Sensitivity restricts each record to its first qualifying complete hour. Patient-equal summaries still combine all repeat records within patient; this is not claimed to be the first chronological operation per patient.
selection.carry: Build display on full frozen QC reference before applying evaluation mask, retaining original absolute phase and valid prewindow history. Unavailable before first valid scheduled sample; missing scheduled values do not update display. Do not reset at hour boundaries.

configurations.phase_aggregation: Mean raw additive components within record before summing records within patient or taking ratios

event_features_at65_5min.preceding_observed_normal_gap: <60s,60_to_lt300s,>=300s; unknown if normal segment touches evaluation boundary, missing reference or record start without an observed preceding low bin. Do not convert unknown to long gap.
event_features_at65_5min.grouping: Each feature separately, no data-selected interactions. Missing reference breaks all low episodes; no gap bridging. Fresh sample, inherited-only low display and never-low are mutually exclusive.
event_features_at65_5min.analytic_check: Under periodic instantaneous sampling on a complete low run, all-phase fresh probability equals min(1,event_bins/interval_bins). Verify, report as a mathematical baseline, not a new empirical clinical discovery.

estimands.pooled: Sum phase-averaged raw components over patients then take ratios; area ratios are burden-weighted and event ratios event-weighted
estimands.patient_equal: Sum record components within each patient, derive patient-specific metrics, then arithmetic mean and quantiles. AUC ratios require patient referenceAUC>0, event ratios require>=1 event; state minutes/hour require selected time>0. Report all denominator counts and do not fill undefined with0.
estimands.absolute_units: AUC mmHg min; TWA mmHg per valid reference minute; state discrepancy minutes per selected observed hour, not labelled anaesthesia-hour outside VitalDB
estimands.paired_difference: Compute paired patient-cluster bootstrap of minute-minus-native in same record-hour positions. Episode counts differ across resolutions; this is not a one-to-one episode matching or clinical equivalence test.
estimands.standardization_gate: Optional duration-standardized minute event fractions only if every shared duration band has>=20 patients and>=50 events in all3sources; fixed VitalDB event-duration weights, conditional CI, no causal or database-effect test. If gate fails, report no standardization, do not collapse bands after viewing effects.

sensitivities: First-reference initialization for ALL phases at first finite reference time, separate from legacy nonzero-phase manuscript rule
Held-value age limited to one sampling interval; missing display remains distinct from normal
Boundary-complete low episodes have observed normal reference immediately before and after the run
Minute first-bin instead of median for VitalDB/MIMIC, evaluated in fixed median-selected hours
VitalDB objective core60 onset on the fixed primary-selected hours, with loss of valid coverage explicitly reported
SICdb same-family pressure coherence and exclusion of>=10min identical runs in fixed primary hours

subgroup_gate.SICdb_ICU: Verify original ICUOffset field semantics; minute bins fully at/after first ICU assignment can be separately evaluated, pre-ICU not automatically surgery
subgroup_gate.surgical_postoperative: Use explicit source categories/verified admission or surgery records only. General surgical service is not proof of postoperative status. No diagnosis-name keyword inference or imported phenotype from another project.
subgroup_gate.minimum_reporting: Subgroup or stratum with<10 patients: suppress effect estimates and label insufficient. 10-19 patients or<50 events: descriptive point estimates only. >=20 patients and>=50 events: patient-bootstrap CI, still no claim of validated clinical subgroup.
subgroup_gate.failure: If data unavailable, timing not linkable or semantics ambiguous, complete the feasibility audit with NO-GO and no invented subgroup estimates. Do not delay the other analyses.

verification: Test boundaries before implementation; independently rederive core components, event partitions, equal-patient summaries and paired bridge on deterministic samples, verify all aggregate identities and protected hashes. Use tolerances fixed at component atol1e-7 rtol1e-10, metrics/CI atol1e-9 rtol1e-9; counts exact except averaged phase counts atol1e-9.
delivery: Independent local report, all aggregate tables in ONE workbook on different sheets, scientific figures and local SHA256manifest. IDs and trajectories remain restricted. No raw datasets redistributed.
